messages:
incident-bot: PAGE INC-3623456789 — euc3: elevated 5xx + ALB path-flap detected, impacting /v1/generate endpoints in eu-central-3a. Severity: S2. Pager duty: @Liz (oncall). Details: https://incidents.redwood.example/3623456789

Liz (oncall): reading metrics now — thanks. Anyone seeing recent deploys? :eyes:

Sam (neteng): no deploys in last 30m from deploy-bot. Seeing backend routing divergence across AZs — requests from eu-central-3a hitting NLB that routes to older Envoy fleet in 3c occasionally.

Diego (sre): logs show a spike in `x-envoy-upstream-rq-per-host` errors and connection resets. Sample from envoy logs:

```
[2026-03-15T12:13:02Z] upstream_reset: connection failure, host=10.12.5.23: connect error (ECONNRESET)
[2026-03-15T12:13:03Z] 5xx: route /v1/generate delay 234ms -> 504
```

Maria (product): frontline reports customer errors for streaming responses. Severity: some customers seeing partial payloads and retries. Need customer impact estimate.

James (support): support queue has ~12 new P1 tickets in EU region. Affected customers: 3 production tenants (names sent to SOC). I'll open a shared doc.

Liz (oncall): ok, immediate goals: 1) isolate whether ALB or NLB is misrouting, 2) stop traffic to unhealthy Envoy hosts, 3) communicate to customers. Sam, can you run a path trace from the ALB to backend pods?

Sam (neteng): running `curl -v` from healthprobe in eu-central-3a to the ALB target group and dumping connection path. Output:

```
$ curl -v https://alb-euc3.example/v1/generate -H 'Host: api.redwood'
* Connected to alb-euc3.example (18.66.12.45) port 443 (#0)
* Server certificate: OK
> GET /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< x-envoy-upstream-rq-timeout
```

Tracing NLB target resolution shows some targets in target-group-a still registered from older autoscaled ASG (3c).

Diego (sre): I see container restarts for envoy on nodes in 3c starting at 12:05Z — likely a config drift on that AZ. Attaching kube events snippet:

```
Warning  BackOff  1m kubelet back-off restarting failed container envoy
Event  Scheduled  30m  default-scheduler  Successfully assigned ingress/envoy-3c-abc to ip-10-12-5-23
```

Liz (oncall): that matches. Sam, can we temporarily drain the NLB targets in AZ 3c? We want to avoid ALB path splitting to unhealthy Envoys.

Sam (neteng): starting drain on target-group-a for AZ 3c now -> `aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn tg-abc --targets Id=i-0a1b2c3d` . Will monitor target health. ETA 30s.

deploy-bot: No active deployments in last 60 minutes. Canary rollouts: none.

James (support): Sending customer message template to affected tenants now: short note and ETA. cc @Maria.

Maria (product): please include ETA: mitigation in progress, full root cause investigation will follow. Mention potential retry requirement for streams.

Sam (neteng): AWS target group health for remaining targets stabilizing. ALB is now routing traffic to 3a/3b only. Initial 5xx rate down ~70%. Metrics: 5xx from 18rpm -> 6rpm.

Diego (sre): I'm kicking a rolling restart of envoy pods in 3c to reduce restart loops after deregistration. Command: `kubectl rollout restart daemonset/envoy -n ingress --field-selector spec.nodeSelector.beta.kubernetes.io/zone=euc3c`

Liz (oncall): good. Diego, after restart, run an `ip route` / `ss -n` check on one node to ensure connections are healthy.

Diego (sre): did that. `ss` showed a backlog of half-open connections on 3c nodes earlier; now cleared. No new restarts after rolling restart.

Sam (neteng): ALB 5xx now back down to baseline. NLB still had some cached routes in edge caches but those are expiring.

James (support): customers confirmed degraded -> recovered in Prod via our messages. One customer asked whether we changed retry semantics; answered: no code change, routing mitigation only.

Maria (product): impact summary for postmortem: Region euc3, AZ euc3c had Envoy process instability causing NLB/ALB path-flap and intermittent 5xx for /v1/generate streaming. Mitigation: drained AZ targets, restarted Envoy, cleared edge caches. Customer impact: 12 P1 tickets, ~45 minutes of intermittent errors for affected tenants.

Liz (oncall): I'm keeping this thread open for 1h for postmortem notes. Diego/Sam, please collect logs and config diffs for 3c nodes. Tag me when done. I'll flip the incident to 'triage' in the tracker. :white_check_mark:

Diego (sre): copying logs to /incidents/3623456789/artifacts and saving `kubectl get nodes -o wide` output.

Sam (neteng): saving ELB target-group change history and route tables to same artifacts dir.

incident-bot: Incident status updated: INC-3623456789 -> mitigated -> triage. Pager cleared for oncall.

Liz (oncall): thanks team. We'll draft a short customer postmortem and link the artifacts. Closing channel in 60m if no regressions. :lock:
